The '''Rainbow Shell''' is found via [[foraging]] at [[The Beach]] in the Summer. It may also spawn on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] during any season or in [[The Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest. It may also be sent in the mail as a gift from [[Demetrius]] or received as a gift from [[Jas]], [[Vincent]] or [[Leo]] at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. A [[Rainbow Trout]] [[Fish Pond]] has a 2% chance to produce 1 Rainbow Shell daily when the population of the pond reaches 9. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] turtle with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|300}}.

==Bundles==
Rainbow Shell is not used in any [[Bundles]].

==Recipes==
Rainbow Shell is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Rainbow Shell is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt134.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Bikini Top]].

Using a Rainbow Shell with the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to [[Dyeing|dye]] clothing will open a menu where any color can be chosen using slider buttons.

==Quests==
*1 Rainbow Shell is used in [[Quests#The Mysterious Qi|The Mysterious Qi]] quest.
*1 Rainbow Shell may be requested by [[Blobfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10.

==Notes==
*An exploit to get the Rainbow Shell is to wait until Demetrius sends a gift in the mail, then reload the game until the shell is received.
